title: Conditionals
explanation: An if block runs only when its condition is true; else if and else handle the other cases. Conditions use == != < > <= >=, joined with && for and, || for or.
The rule that trips up every Java beginner: compare text with .equals(...), not ==. Save == for numbers and booleans.
This lesson reads the real block under your feet and reacts to it. Go stand on sand, in water, or on a rooftop and run it again.
